import smtplib

def send_email(to, subject, body, smtp_host='localhost', smtp_port=25):
    server = smtplib.SMTP(smtp_host, smtp_port)
    message = f'Subject: {subject}\n\n{body}'
    server.sendmail('noreply@example.com', to, message)
    server.quit()
    return True

import pytest
from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch
from email_sender import send_email

def test_send_email_returns_true():
    mock_server = MagicMock()
    with patch('email_sender.smtplib.SMTP', return_value=mock_server):
        result = send_email('user@example.com', 'Hello', 'World')
    assert result is True
    mock_server.sendmail.assert_called_once()
    mock_server.quit.assert_called_once()
